items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And so, after three weeks, and I said, “Jimmy, it’s time to hit for a raise now,” you know. So we went to the guy, and said it’s time for us to get a raise.

ctx.x: And so, after three weeks, and I said, “Jimmy, it’s time to hit for a raise now,” you know. So we went to the guy, and said it’s time for us to get a raise. He said, “I’m not going to give you a raise,” he told me. I said, “Okay then we’ll go somewhere else. He said, “No, don’t do that.” He said, “But if I give you a raise, I have to give the organ player a raise, because he’s a man.” I said, “But he’s not playing anything.
